sourceKind: Decoded from the CharacterCustomizingRule .loa documents. scalarVariables carry defaultValue, the first float of the record, plus the remaining floats of that record in source order, left unnamed because the documents do not name them. A record payload runs to the length prefix of the next authored variable, so a long payload can include trailing document bytes that belong to no variable; payloadBytes is reported so that is visible rather than hidden. booleanVariables hold no decoded default in these documents, so none is stated.
